articles.title: Did F&O or intraday trading last year? Your ITR filing due date isn't July 31
articles.summary: In India, intraday and F&O trading profits are taxed differently. Intraday trading is speculative business income, while F&O is non-speculative. Taxpayers must file ITR-3 or ITR-4 depending on specific conditions. Here are the deadlines.

articles.title: Claiming a deceased family member's mutual funds made less cumbersome: What SEBI has changed

articles.title: Job switch leads to ₹1.69 lakh tax liability despite both employers deducting TDS correctly: Here's why Form 12B matters
articles.summary: Switching jobs during a financial year can leave salaried employees with an unexpected tax liability even if both employers deducted TDS correctly. The gap arises because TDS is calculated employer-wise, while final tax is based on total annual income. Form 12B can help avoid this mismatch.

articles.title: How to lock and unlock your fingerprints and iris using new Aadhaar App
articles.summary: The Aadhaar biometric lock/unlock feature has gained significant adoption, with residents using it more than 1.91 crore times, according to MeitY. This security feature allows Aadhaar holders to prevent unauthorized biometric authentication using their fingerprints, iris and face data.

articles.title: The NRI guilt trap: why high salaries abroad don't always create wealth

articles.title: National Student Laptop Scheme 2026 is fake: PIB Fact Check reiterates warning against viral WhatsApp message

articles.title: Hotels can't add a service charge to your bill without informing you: CCPA acts against 41 restaurants
articles.summary: CCPA has initiated action against 41 restaurants for automatically adding service charges to customers' bills, calling it an unfair trade practice. The move reinforces that service charges are voluntary, and restaurants must not levy them by default or without clearly informing consumers.
